title: Personal Finance Platform
summary: A private money ledger for life in Nigeria. It tracks money across a bank account, OPay or Moniepoint wallets, cash and savings in one place. It handles transfers, split payments, monthly budgets, recurring payments and bank-statement imports. Balances are worked out from the ledger entries, never typed in, and only the owner can see their data, not even an admin.
body: Àpò (Yoruba for “pouch” or “purse”) is Day 22 of my 30-day challenge, and the focus was getting money right. Most Nigerians I know keep their money in several places at once: a bank account, OPay or Moniepoint, cash, and a savings app. No single app shows the whole picture, so I built one.
